start_action_outcome: clean repo with first ask -> edit file, run check, inspect /diff, press Esc -> closing PASS report, changed file in /diff, terminal completed sidecar
invariant: completed run stays terminal with stable runId and verified check; Esc returns from review to composer
unmodellable_part: provider natural-language edit and closing prose plus interactive PTY /diff review rendering
waiver_reason: free-form LLM reply selection and terminal review layout are not a finite transition table; run-lifecycle persistence is modelled separately by run-identity-resume

start_action_outcome: failing check on repo -> run failing check, edit root cause, re-run passing check, inspect /diff -> root cause and PASS prose visible, changed file listed in /diff
invariant: diagnosis prose, fixed file diff, and post-fix verified status agree without stale failures
unmodellable_part: provider root-cause diagnosis prose and interactive PTY /diff review rendering
waiver_reason: natural-language diagnosis and terminal layout cannot be reduced to a finite state oracle; edit-invalidates-verification persistence is modelled separately by run-identity-resume

start_action_outcome: mid-flight multi-stage run -> resume session and navigate /run, /tasks, /diff, /workbench -> seeded plan and ask visible across specialist panels
invariant: deliverable states and open work remain consistent across specialist commands without dropping open items
unmodellable_part: provider multi-stage planning prose and multi-command PTY visibility across /run, /tasks, /diff, and /workbench
waiver_reason: cross-screen PTY prose rendering and planning wording require terminal inspection; the deliverable completion guard is modelled separately by run-identity-resume

start_action_outcome: active multi-stage session -> close, torn boot, restart, and run-mode --resume -> runId, unique deliverables, unique changedPaths, and monotonic writeSeq survive
invariant: restart and torn-write recovery preserve work identity, deliverable uniqueness, path deduplication, and monotonic sidecar revision

start_action_outcome: resumed run with typed draft -> open palette Ctrl+X p to /workbench or /diff and press Esc -> unsent draft and durable five-item work identity survive excursion
invariant: unsent composer draft text and durable work identity survive palette excursions and Esc return
unmodellable_part: interactive PTY keystroke timing, command-palette handoff, and terminal composer draft retention
waiver_reason: raw escape-sequence input timing and composer buffer rendering are PTY UI behavior; surface-route return and work-identity persistence are modelled separately by surface-route-sessions and run-identity-resume

start_action_outcome: installed version v1 -> switch to v2, re-switch, rollback/restore previous -> current.txt and previous.txt move atomically without temp residue and user state survives
invariant: version pointer swaps never clobber previous with current, rollback restores prior version, and no staging temp files remain

start_action_outcome: signed-in first account -> /logins or boot-face browser OAuth sign-in as second account -> token exchange lands, account switches, and Login successful receipt renders
invariant: OAuth callback binds state, replaces stored account identity atomically, and renders a truthful receipt on chat and boot-face entry points
unmodellable_part: external browser launch, loopback OAuth HTTP redirect and token exchange, OS credential storage, and dual-entry PTY login receipt rendering
waiver_reason: browser handoff, HTTP callback cryptography, and keychain/TTY receipt verification depend on external process and transport boundaries verified by the fixture loopback drive

start_action_outcome: two live sessions A and B -> enter A, switch to B, attempt stale return token from A or valid return from B -> stale token from A is refused on B and valid return pops one frame
invariant: a stale return token from session A after a fresh transition to session B never navigates back; valid LIFO return tokens match the independent transition table

start_action_outcome: pending worker permission asks -> allow, deny, replay answer, withdraw, or retire asks -> each ask settles at most once and queue position/total stay truthful
invariant: a permission answer is consumed at most once; replayed, withdrawn, and retired request IDs are refused and queue position/total arithmetic holds

start_action_outcome: concourse worker schedule -> add, pause, resume, hold fire, take held fire, mark fired, or remove -> paused schedules are not due, one-shot fires spend once, holds deduplicate, and remove drops holds
invariant: one-shot schedules spend at most once, held fires deduplicate on (scheduleId, dueAt) and are taken at most once, pause suppresses due time, and remove leaves no orphan holds

start_action_outcome: long session context -> trigger manual/auto compaction through stages to landed, cancelled, or failed -> stages advance monotonically, fill stays clamped, and exit freezes status
invariant: fold stages never regress, summary fill is monotonic in [0,1], terminal exit ignores later progress events, and status JSON decodes losslessly

start_action_outcome: interview session -> open, append, duplicate-append, drain, restart, resume, and concurrent drain/append -> accepted events survive drain and restart in order without duplication
invariant: every accepted interview event settles durably once in order, duplicate appends are no-ops, and restart/resume reconstructs the exact folded state
